q: How does an Ambur shoe upper unit work out electricity per pair?
title: Ambur shoe uppers: power per pair
short: Multiply the month's billed kWh by 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25 and divide by pairs of uppers stitched. Cutting, skiving and stitching machines run on grid power, so for an upper unit this is the main own-energy line.
audience: Shoe upper and footwear component units in the Ambur and Vaniyambadi cluster of Tamil Nadu

p: Multiply by 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25.
Divide by pairs of uppers finished.
Leather from the tannery is your largest bought input. Ask the tannery for its figure per square foot and add it per pair.

example.note: Quantities are illustrative; the factor is the CEA grid average.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
